snippet.title: Silver - Video Game Trailer. (FR, 1999). PC Windows/Macintosh/Dreamcast
snippet.description:
Silver : official video game  French trailer. 
Developed by Infogrames UK Ltd.
Published by Infogrames in 1999 for PC Windows, then in 2000 for Macintosh (ported by Spiral House) and Dreamcast (ported by Spiral House).
 
Year :  1999 
System : PC (Windows), Macintosh, Dreamcast 

Video found on the coverdisk from the French magazine Generation 4 (issue #121, April 1999)
